Real-world performance data on the combined sorbent and filter design will drive further refinement and establish optimal operating conditions for the next scale of demonstration. Using the 1-kg/day system’s results, structured sorbent filter will be scaled up and demonstrated in Susteon’s 15- kg/day integrated bench-scale system (developed under DE-FE0032243). This system is illustrated in Figure 9 and will represent transitioning from a component test to a fully integrated system and generate valuable insights. In parallel, Susteon will collaborate with its filter manufacturing partner to address the structured sorbent filter manufacturing methods and QA/QC protocols to meet the quantities and material performance required for the 15- kg/day system. Throughout this process, Susteon will proactively engage with commercial partners and potential customers to assess the feasibility of scaling this DAC technology and derisk technical and commercial risks. Successful demonstration and derisking at the 15 kg/day scale will be followed by a pilot-scale design for a commercial 1 TPD system. Major post-project activities are summarized in Table 2. To address manufacturing challenges such as the adhesive obscuring CO 2 capture sites, Susteon will collaborate with its commercial manufacturing Structured Sorbent Filter partner to investigate different approaches (formulations, quantities, Manufacturing manufacturing methods, etc.). Additionally, other form factors will be explored to deploy the sorbent. Examples include rotating wheels and granules in fixed bed columns. In parallel with continued sorbent and structured filter improvements, the technology will be scaled up and integrated into Susteon’s 15-kg CO /day 2 integrated bench-scale system. This system was developed under DE- Integrated Bench-scale Demonstration FE0032243. Demonstration at this scale will help derisk the technology before further scale-up and generate performance data which will inform the technoeconomic analysis of this DAC technology. After demonstrating and derisking at the integrated bench-scale, Susteon will use the data generated at 15-kg/day scale to design a demonstration facility capable of up to 1 TPD CO capture and determine the funding Pilot-Scale Design 2 needed for the construction and testing of the DAC system.
